messages:
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Canary alert @channel: p95 latency crossed threshold (1.8x) for route /v1/generate on model redwood-3b-quant at 09:12 UTC. Suggested action: auto-rollback to v2.3.1. Reason: kernel OOMs spiking. 
Mia: seeing the same from devtools — but traffic slice looks biased to long-context tests.
Alex: can we validate with a quick sampling before nuking the rollout? last deploy was 10m ago.
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback is *enabled* for this workspace. Current policy: trigger if p95 > 1.5x for >5m.
Sam (sre): hold on autos. I think this is noisy — our synthetic load generator started at 09:08 and skews seq len. +1. Alex can you run `scripts/traffic-slice-check.sh --route /v1/generate`?
Alex: running now, attaching quick output: ```
> ./traffic-slice-check.sh --route /v1/generate
slices: 5
slice-3: avg_len=1200, qps=12
slice-4: avg_len=42, qps=8
note: slice-3 is synthetic-long-run
```
Priya (product): if this is synthetic-only, we should avoid rollback — customers see flapping in release notes. Can we pin instead and cut traffic to v2.3.2 for real traffic?
Sam (sre): propose manual partial rollback: pin gateway for production traffic to v2.3.0 and keep canary on 2.3.2 until we confirm. Command: `rwctl pin route /v1/generate --version 2.3.0 --scope production`
Mia: +1 for pin. Also we should open a short incident ticket and notify CS if we change routing.
Jordan (legal): heads-up — if we change behavior for EU customers, need the EU comms snippet. But pinning to previous GA is fine. Please include a brief release note diff.
Priya (product): OK drafting short note: "Traffic pin to v2.3.0 for /v1/generate due to observed latency on long-context synthetic workloads; no customer-facing impact expected." Will post to #customer-announce if we go live.
Sam (sre): oncall-bot can you run the pin now? @oncall-bot run `rwctl pin` (dry-run then apply)
oncall-bot: @Sam (sre) running dry-run: `rwctl pin --route /v1/generate --version 2.3.0 --scope production --dry-run` -> OK. Ready to apply.
Alex: also pushed a quick kprobe to check kernel OOM trend: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime | grep -i oom` -> no new OOMs in last 3m.
Sam (sre): applying pin in 30s. Notifying CS and legal. If any anomaly within 5m we will revert to auto-rollback.
Mia: posting to #customer-ops now. 
Priya (product): 👍 once pin is applied I'll update release notes and prepare rollback comms if needed.
deploy-bot: Action: `rwctl pin` applied by Sam at 09:16:12 UTC. Traffic shift: prod -> 100% v2.3.0, canary remains v2.3.2 at 5% test slice.
Alex: monitoring p95: back to baseline for production slices. Canary p95 still elevated on synthetic slice.
Jordan (legal): thanks. Keep me looped if we alter EU routing.
Sam (sre): closing thread — decision: manual pin (no full auto-rollback) due to detected synthetic noise. Follow-up: add filter in monitor to exclude long-context synthetic slice and tweak deploy policy to require cross-slice confirmation before auto-rollback. Filing follow-up ticket: INF-4721. :white_check_mark:
